description: This file declares structures and functions related to process sandbox policies in the Android Cuttlefish project. It defines the HostInfo struct, several policy functions returning sandbox2::PolicyBuilder objects for different components, and utility functions for policy management and host information handling.

classes.name: HostInfo
classes.description: Holds configuration paths and directories required for setting up sandbox policies and host environment information.

methods.name: EnsureOutputDirectoriesExist
methods.description: Ensures that all output directories specified in HostInfo exist.

methods.description: Returns the full path to a host tool executable given its name.
